claims.statement: Mike McCoole and Tom Allen agreed at Alex. McKee's to withdraw the stakes on their match and postpone the battle.
claims.excerpt: Meeting at Alex. MeKee's last night, and it was agreed that tile stakes put up on the match

claims.statement: The postponed McCoole-Allen battle was to come off in about two months.
claims.excerpt: for a mill. to come off in abont two months
